body: The FP10 prescription printer in the GP room won't print. Patients are waiting for their prescriptions and the GP can't issue them.

subject: Print queue stuck
body: There's a 300 page document stuck at the top of the queue for the 3rd floor printer and nobody can delete it. Everything else is stuck behind it.

subject: Scanner saves blank pages
body: Scans from the printer by the kitchen come out as blank white pages, both sides. Copying works fine.

subject: New printer for satellite office
body: We're opening a small satellite office at the Wembley hub with 8 staff. Could we get a printer installed and set up before the 1st of next month?

subject: Printing very slow
body: Printing takes about 10 minutes to come out at the moment. It does come out eventually.

subject: Card reader on printer
body: The card reader on the printer doesn't recognise my new ID badge, says 'card not registered'. My old badge worked.

subject: Toner smudging
body: Toner is smudging on everything and rubs off on our hands. Can someone have a look at the printer near the lifts?

subject: Scan folder
body: Could a scan to folder destination be set up for our team so scans go straight to the team drive?

subject: Printer jammed again!!
body: printer jammed AGAIN on the ground floor. third time this week. can someone actually fix it properly

subject: Wrong default printer
body: My laptop keeps switching my default printer to one on a different floor so I have to walk up two floors to collect prints. Small thing.

subject: Label printer
body: The label printer in pharmacy prints labels misaligned so the text is cut off. We need it for dispensing so we're hand writing labels at the moment.

subject: Order paper
body: We've run out of A3 paper for the plotter. Who orders it?

subject: Duplex not working
body: The printer won't print double sided any more, the option is greyed out in the print settings.

subject: Printer for new starter
body: Please can the team printer and scanner be set up on our new starter's laptop before Monday.

subject: All printers offline at the Civic Centre
body: Every printer at the Civic Centre is showing offline for all staff since the network work last night. Committee papers have to be printed by noon today.

subject: Phishing email
body: Got an email saying it's from DocuSign with a document to review from someone I've never heard of. Looks dodgy so I haven't opened it. Forwarding it to you.

subject: I clicked a link :(
body: I'm so sorry, I clicked a link in an email about a parcel delivery and then put my work email and password in. I realised straight away. What do I do?

subject: Laptop left on the bus
body: I left my work laptop on the 87 bus this morning. I've reported it to TfL lost property. It has BitLocker I think.

subject: Strange pop up
body: A pop up came up on my screen saying my computer is infected and I need to call Microsoft on a number. It won't go away. I haven't called it.

subject: Email to wrong person
body: I sent a letter about a child protection case to the wrong parent's email address 10 minutes ago. I've asked them to delete it. Who do I need to tell?

subject: MFA approvals I didn't do
body: My phone has had about 15 sign in approval requests in the last hour and I haven't been signing in. I've denied them all.

subject: Is this genuine?
body: We've had an email from someone claiming to be our chief exec asking for an urgent bank transfer to a new supplier. The email address looks slightly wrong. Finance team are all holding off.

subject: Work phone stolen
body: My bag was snatched outside the station last night with my work phone in it. Police crime ref attached.

subject: Antivirus alert
body: Defender says it found Trojan:Win32 and quarantined it after I downloaded a PDF from a supplier's website.

subject: Encrypted USB please
body: Could I have an encrypted memory stick for taking presentation files to schools? They don't let us use OneDrive links.

subject: Can I use WhatsApp?
body: Is it OK to use WhatsApp on my work phone to message families? Some prefer it to texts.

subject: Files renamed .locked
body: All the files in our team folder on the S drive have changed to .locked and there's a text file called README_RESTORE. I can't open anything. Others in the team the same.

subject: Account sending spam
body: People are telling me they've had strange emails from my account with a link to a voicemail. I didn't send them.

subject: Spam text pretending to be IT
body: Got a text saying it's from the IT service desk asking me to confirm my login on a link. Didn't click it. Just letting you know.

subject: Lost smartcard
body: I can't find my smartcard anywhere, I think I dropped it in the car park yesterday. I need it cancelled and a new one.

subject: Suspicious login alert
body: I got an email from Microsoft saying there was unusual sign in activity on my account from Brazil. I'm in Leeds.

subject: Shared spreadsheet with wrong group
body: I shared a spreadsheet with staff sickness records with the whole team site by accident instead of just my manager. About 40 people could have seen it for an hour before I noticed.

subject: Security questionnaire from supplier
body: A new software supplier has sent us a security questionnaire to complete about our IT. Which team should fill this in? They need it by the end of the month.

subject: Personal email forwarding
body: Can I set up my work email to forward to my Gmail? It's easier on my phone.

subject: Phishing
body: fyi lots of us in housing have had the same 'invoice overdue' email with a zip file. nobody has opened it as far as I know

subject: Someone called asking for my password
body: A man rang my desk saying he was from IT and asked me to read out the code from my authenticator. I told him the code before I realised. It was about 20 minutes ago.

subject: Tailgating
body: Someone followed me through the secure door into the records room without a badge this morning. They said they were a contractor. Should I report this to someone?

subject: USB stick found
body: I found a USB stick in the car park with 'Salaries 2026' written on it. I haven't plugged it in. Who should I give it to?

subject: Ransom note on screen
body: My screen has gone red with a message saying my files are encrypted and to pay in bitcoin. I've pulled the network cable out. Please help NOW.

subject: Approved file sharing
body: What is the approved way to send a large set of case files to the police? They asked for Dropbox but I'm not sure that's allowed.

subject: Wifi down across hospital
body: Staff wifi is down across the whole hospital, every ward and department. Mobile devices for drug rounds and bed management are offline.

subject: Can't connect to VPN after new laptop
body: Got my replacement laptop and the VPN client isn't on it. I'm home based so I need it to do anything.

subject: Teams calls breaking up in office
body: On the 3rd floor Teams calls keep freezing and people sound robotic, but it's fine at home. Seems to be a network issue in the building, happens for everyone up here.

subject: Static IP for device
body: Our new door entry system needs a fixed IP address on the network. The installer is coming next Friday.

subject: Network drive request
body: Could a new shared drive be created for the Estates team with about 50GB of space?

subject: Wifi keeps asking to sign in
body: Every morning my laptop connects to the wifi but then asks me to sign in on a web page that doesn't load.

subject: Internet down in contact centre
body: The contact centre has lost internet. Agents can't use the CRM or webchat and the public can't get through online. 45 agents on shift.

subject: home broadband
body: Is there any help for home broadband? Mine keeps dropping and I work from home 3 days a week.

subject: Remote access to CCTV
body: Security team need to view the CCTV system from the control room at another site. Can network access be set up between the two?

subject: Drive access very slow over VPN
body: Over VPN the P drive takes forever to open folders. In the office it's fine. Just me as far as I know.

subject: Printer showing error 49
body: The HP printer by finance shows 49 service error, power cycled it twice. Our team can't print payment runs.

subject: Print from phone
body: Is there a way to print from my work phone? I'm often out on visits and need to print forms when I get back.

subject: Faint printing
body: Prints from the reception printer are really faint, barely readable. The toner says it's half full.

subject: Plotter not printing
body: The A0 plotter in planning won't print large drawings, it starts then stops halfway. We have a planning committee tomorrow and need the boards printed today.

subject: Remove old printer
body: Please remove the old ground floor printer from our laptops, it was taken away last month and people keep sending jobs to it.

subject: Envelopes jamming
body: The printer jams every time we feed envelopes through the bypass tray. Is there a setting we're missing?

subject: Scan to email size limit
body: Scanning a 60 page document to email fails, smaller scans work. I need to send the whole bundle to our solicitors.

subject: Printing in wrong tray
body: Letters keep printing on the headed paper in tray 2 instead of plain paper from tray 1. We're wasting loads of headed paper.

subject: Cannot print to any printers
body: My laptop has no printers listed at all any more. Add printer can't find anything. Everyone else can print.

subject: Toner order for 4 printers
body: Could we order black toner for the four printers in the Guildhall? We've only got one spare left.

subject: Wristband printer
body: The patient wristband printer in A&E is printing blank bands. We can't admit patients without wristbands, using handwritten ones for now.

subject: Secure print PIN
body: How do I set a PIN for secure printing? I print confidential HR letters and don't want them sitting in the tray.

subject: Printer making grinding noise
body: The printer on our floor is making a loud grinding noise and pages come out creased. Still printing for now.

subject: Scanner not sending to OCR folder
body: Scans to the OCR folder stopped working this week, the files never appear on the shared drive. Others in my team say the same.

subject: New multifunction printer delivery
body: A new MFD is being delivered to the Leeds office next Tuesday. Could someone set it up on the network and add it to the print server?

subject: Phishing - finance
body: Our accounts payable inbox got an email from a known supplier saying their bank details have changed. It's come from a slightly different domain. We haven't paid anything.

subject: Gave code to caller
body: Someone phoned pretending to be the bank and I read out the code from my work authenticator app. I've just realised it was a scam.

subject: iPad stolen from car
body: Work iPad stolen from my car overnight while parked at home. It's got the case management app on it. Crime reference to follow.

subject: Clicked attachment
body: opened an attachment from an email that said 'payment remittance', it asked me to enable content and i did. nothing seemed to happen

subject: Password manager
body: Can we use a password manager like 1Password for our team's shared logins? What's approved?

subject: Wrong attachment sent externally
body: I attached the wrong spreadsheet to an email to an external partner, it contained residents' names, addresses and benefit amounts. The partner has confirmed deletion.

subject: Weird browser behaviour
body: My browser keeps opening tabs to gambling sites on its own and my search engine has changed. I think I've got something nasty.

subject: Suspicious QR code
body: There's a QR code poster in the staff kitchen saying 'scan to claim your staff bonus'. It doesn't look official. Can someone check?

subject: Security training
body: Where can I find the annual cyber security training? My manager says mine is overdue.

subject: Lost work phone
body: I've lost my work mobile, last had it in a taxi on the way back from a home visit. It has my email on it.

subject: Account hacked?
body: My password stopped working and when I reset it I saw a rule in Outlook moving all my emails to RSS feeds that I didn't create.

subject: Report spam
body: Getting loads of spam emails about crypto investments every day. Is there a way to block them? Not dangerous I don't think, just annoying.

subject: Bring your own device
body: Am I allowed to use my own laptop to work from home if I install the antivirus? My work one is being repaired.

subject: Data sent to printer at wrong site
body: I accidentally printed a batch of patient discharge letters to a printer at the wrong hospital site. I don't know who collected them.

subject: Fake login page
body: Saw a link in a Teams chat from an external account that goes to a page that looks exactly like our sign in page. I didn't enter anything. Thought you should know.

subject: Laptop fan and lights but no screen
body: Laptop powers on, fans spin and the caps lock light flashes but the screen stays black. Tried an external monitor too.

subject: Need a bigger monitor
body: I work on large spreadsheets all day, could I get a wider monitor? My manager is fine with it.

subject: Payroll software error
body: The payroll system errors with 'Unable to connect to the database' when we start the BACS run. Payroll must be submitted by 3pm today or staff won't be paid on time.

subject: Install R
body: Please install R and RStudio. I'm in public health intelligence and we're moving our analysis from SPSS.
